description: Easy Delivery Co. is a game about delivering packages.

v0.0.4.description:
# **Changes**
Added option for perfect deliveries
Added option to add locations for blind bags
Added option to add locations for snowcats
Fixed generating with more than one Easy Delivery Co. player
v0.0.4.title: Easy Delivery Co. Archipelago v0.0.4

v0.1.0.description:
## Hotfix
Fixes the factory_only blocked tunnel option not working  properly in-game
No apworld changes
## Changes
Added yaml option to add locations and items for radio towers
Added yaml option to block tunnels behind receiving items
Added yaml option to prevent entering the factory without the handheld radio
Added yaml option to receive car upgrades directly
Added a simple in-game tracker to see what items are received and how many locations are checked
Added in-game settings (click "mods" in the bottom right corner of the options)
Moved the DeathLink toggle to the settings
Connection details now gets saved in the savefile
Opening a save now attempts to connect to the saved connection. Can be toggled in the settings
The in-game archipelago console/text client is now a default off setting
## Notes
⚠️ The in-game tracker can only be closed by the x in the top right corner
Intercity jobs doesn't take tunnels and radio towers as items into account. This should be accounted for in the logic, but might cause some confusion
v0.1.0.title: Easy Delivery Co. Archipelago v0.1.0

v0.1.2.description:
## Changes
When choosing a delivery it now shows if there's a hinted item with an exclamation mark
Intercity deliveries will not be generated if the required items haven't been received
Deliveries wont be generated when not connected to Archipelago
Lowered time spent dead (might not apply the first time after starting the game)

## Bugfix
Fixed Fishing Town gate not opening on when it should when using the "only items" option for Radio Towers

## Notes
No APWorld changes from v0.1.0
⚠️ The in-game tracker can only be closed by the x in the top right corner
v0.1.2.title: Easy Delivery Co. Archipelago v0.1.2

v0.1.3.description:
## Bugfix
Fix generating intercity deliveries to Fishing Town with the Blocked Tunnels option on
v0.1.3.title: Easy Delivery Co. Archipelago v0.1.3 Hotfix

v0.2.0.description:
## Changes
Added yaml option to lock deliveries to and from towns to require an item, starting with a random town in Mountain Town
Added logic to payload deliveries with the "Lock Towns" option on
Added yaml option to adjust intercity deliveries
Changed filler item generation
APWorld changed to use the Rule Builder, raising the minimum required Archipelago version to 0.6.7
Updated Archipelago.MultiClient.Net to v6.7.1
## Fixes
Fixed how hints are updated. Deliveries should no longer randomly stop generating
Swapped Snowcat Fit and Snowcat Foreman
Now sends all checks from a completed delivery in one packet
## Notes
⚠️ The in-game tracker can only be closed by the x in the top right corner
v0.2.0.title: Easy Delivery Co. Archipelago v0.2.0
